name: Live Website Lyrics
author: Lights on Elizabeth
description: Shares current song and playback timing with a website sing-along display.

privacy.summary: Sends song filename, playback state, timing and a session identifier to the configured HTTPS website every two seconds. Does not change FPP playback or lighting.
sends: Current song filename, playback position and state, timestamp and session identifier to the configured website
systemChanges: Installs loe-lyrics.service; migrates the existing sender service when present
privacy.other: Connection key and sequence mapping are stored privately on this player. Uninstall disables lyrics sending.
